Try our Treatment Planner → BioRePeel Your trusted destination for BioRePeel in Boston Seaport Medspa is proud to offer BioRePeel in Boston, an innovative, medical-grade chemical peel from Italy that improves skin clarity, tone, and texture with minimal downtime. Unlike traditional peels that cause heavy peeling, BioRePeel uses a biphasic technology and a blend of active ingredients to gently exfoliate while stimulating collagen and hydration, making it suitable year-round and for all skin types. Book Here What is BioRePeel? How BioRePeel Works BioRePeel uses trichloroacetic acid (TCA) combined with amino acids, vitamins, and GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid) to exfoliate the outer layer of skin while stimulating collagen and elastin in deeper layers. Treatment Process The peel is applied in-office and works in just a few minutes. Patients may feel a mild tingling sensation. Unlike traditional peels, BioRePeel causes minimal visible peeling, with results that appear gradually over several days. Safety and Clinical Use BioRePeel is CE-certified in Europe and widely used in medical aesthetics worldwide. It is considered safe for all skin types and tones when administered by trained providers. Areas Commonly Treated BioRePeel can be used on the face, neck, chest, back, and hands. It is effective for pigmentation, acne, fine lines, uneven texture, and overall skin dullness. BioRePeel at Seaport Medspa A Patient-Focused Approach ​ At Seaport Medspa, BioRePeel® is performed with safety and education as priorities. Providers customize peel protocols based on skin type and treatment goals, ensuring results are balanced, natural, and supportive of long-term skin health. ​ The Science Behind BioRePeel ​ BioRePeel is unique in that it uses biphasic technology: a hydrophilic phase containing active acids and vitamins that exfoliate and stimulate collagen, and a lipophilic phase that protects and hydrates the skin barrier. Its blend of TCA, lactobionic acid, salicylic acid, tartaric acid, amino acids, and vitamins makes it both corrective and restorative. This combination allows BioRePeel to treat acne, pigmentation, fine lines, and dullness while preserving skin hydration and minimizing irritation. ​ The Treatment Experience ​ BioRePeel treatments are quick, usually lasting 15–20 minutes. After cleansing, the peel solution is applied evenly and left for a few minutes before being removed. Patients may experience mild tingling during application. Unlike traditional medium-depth peels, there is little to no visible flaking or downtime, making it easy to return to normal activities right away. ​ Expected Results ​ Skin typically looks brighter and more refreshed within days. With a series of treatments, patients can expect improvement in acne, pigmentation, fine lines, and overall texture. Results build gradually, as collagen stimulation continues for weeks after treatment. ​ Safety and Research ​ BioRePeel is CE-certified in Europe and has been widely adopted for its strong safety profile and effectiveness. Because it causes minimal irritation, it is considered safe across all skin tones and can be performed year-round, even during summer months. Areas of Treatment ​ BioRePeel is versatile and can be used on multiple areas, including the face, neck, chest, back, and hands. It addresses concerns ranging from acne and pigmentation to early signs of aging and uneven texture. Why Choose Seaport Medspa ​ At Seaport Medspa, BioRePeel is offered as part of a medically guided approach to skin health. Our providers combine expertise with patient education to ensure treatments are safe, effective, and natural-looking. This commitment has made us a trusted destination for BioRePeel in Boston.
